== Course of events ==

After the party's escape from the invisible bears in the Valley of Voe, Eureka had been accused by Princess Ozma and ordered imprisoned and put on trial before a jury of nine. During the proceedings, Tin Woodman produced a duplicate piglet, seemingly proving her innocence, yet Eureka herself came forward with the truth. She revealed that the collar presented as evidence did not match the piglet in question, exposing the mismatch at the heart of the accusation.

Having exposed the discrepancy, Eureka confessed what had actually become of the real piglet: it had fallen into a vase. The vase was located and the piglet was found inside it, alive, resolving the confusion that had placed Eureka under suspicion.
